name: AI ECA integration
description: Deprecated and being removed in AI 2.0.0. Submodule of the AI project that formerly bridged AI with ECA; the installed 1.4.x code is only a migration shim to drupal/ai_integration_eca.
project_description: AI ECA integration (ai_eca) is a deprecated submodule of the Drupal AI project. It historically supplied ECA (Event-Condition-Action) action/condition plugins that let no-code ECA models invoke AI operations. As of AI 1.2.0 the functionality was extracted to the standalone contributed module drupal/ai_integration_eca, and ai_eca is scheduled for removal in AI 2.0.0. The installed 1.4.x code is a thin deprecation shim: it ships no plugins, routes, services, permissions or config schema. Its only executable code is the admin-run update hook ai_eca_update_11001, which rewrites existing ECA configuration (module dependencies ai_eca -> ai_integration_eca and plugin IDs ai_eca_* -> ai_integration_eca_*), installs the replacement module, and uninstalls itself.
